Issue: BaseSettings inherits from MutableMapping, which provides default setdefault implementation using __getitem__ and __setitem__. In BaseSettings, __getitem__ returns None for missing keys instead of raising KeyError. This leads setdefault to consider key present (since no KeyError) and returns None, not setting default. Fix: Implement setdefault in BaseSettings to follow mapping semantics: if key not present (i.e., not in self) then set and return default, else return existing value.
